snippet.title: Godless Avalon - Announcement and Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
An adventure RPG with guns! 
Explore unique settings and discover secrets.
Fantasy/comedy with high-stakes and fast pacing.

Play the Demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4194370/Godless_Avalon/
https://finalbossblues.itch.io/godless-avalon

This game is currently in development.
I am the solo developer and an independent pixel artist.
